title: Last War v21 update-safe lifecycle and Dispatch/Secret Task acceleration

findings.result: startup now restores LWBridge files, runs the untouched official launcher/update to completion, closes the clean preflight game, strictly validates the final client, then installs/starts LWBridge; restore-only recovery permits an intermediate updated binary but candidate injection still requires final compatibility approval

v21 safe full-world coverage uses FOV 175, cameraY 220 and AOI-boundary-aligned targets; aspect 4-12 all produce 6x25=150 AOIs; cameraY 240+ enters the unsupported split path; the exact 100x100 AOI union therefore requires 17x4=68 primary requests
500 ms parking settle failed first-request stability; 1 s passed. A separate startup settle was redundant and removed after zero-startup-settle Dispatch and City proofs completed 2500/2500 blocks
full Dispatch scan on server 2175 completed in 7.028 s after startup-settle removal with 2 rows persisted/reopened; same-session warm scans previously measured about 6.28-6.31 s per server
official read-only DispatchFindNearestPoint returns one Secret Task location in about 0.5 s and does not enumerate the full world task set

when Auto Scan includes Dispatch, after confirmed server travel it runs one native Quick Find and emits the coordinate before starting the complete scan; the one-target result is never merged into authoritative scan storage

rejectedExperiments: messagebulk world browser timed out / lacked authoritative empty-batch completion
coverage-chain experiment was not production-proven and was removed
aspect-only tuning cannot beat 6x25 at cameraY 220

validation.mapBrowserCheck: pass including Auto Quick Find before map_scan_start and visible-result event
validation.normalReleaseWindowScript: blocked by local PowerShell execution policy; no policy change attempted

limits: wall time varies with network/world state
Quick Find is one-target only and is not a completeness substitute
68 requests is the best safe footprint proven for the current camera-based v21 path, not a universal theoretical lower bound
normal Release scripted window smoke remains unrerun because the machine blocks .ps1 execution
